 This application coming on for admission this day, the c
 following:
 Order

1 . This is a bail application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 27.2.2023 in connection with Crime No.13/2023, registered at Police Station Khargapur District Tikamgarh for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC and Section 5/6 of the POCSO Act.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and being falsely implicated in the case.
Applicant is a young boy of 22 years of age and was having love affair with the prosecutrix.
Prosecutrix is aged about 16 years and has sufficient maturity and understanding. Investigation is complete.
Charge sheet has been filed.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the application for grant of bail and submitted that offences are serious in nature.
Prosecutrtix is aged about 15 years and 24 days.
She is minor.
Consent is immaterial considering her age.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be enlarged on bail.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5. Investigation is complete.
Charge sheet has been filed.
Prosecutrix is aged about 15 years and was having love affair with applicant.
6 . Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.

8. In addition to aforesaid condition, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE DUBEY/-
